test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of October 2020, who is the CEO of NITI Aayog?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amitabh Kant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amitabh Kant **is the **NITI Aayog's, Chief Executive Officer**. He is a member of the Kerala cadre of the Indian Administrative Service from the 1980 batch.
 
• He edited "The Path Ahead: Transformative Ideas for India" and wrote "Branding India: An Incredible Story" (2009) and "Incredible India 2.0: Synergies of Growth and Governance (2019)".
 
• Kant was also the Chairman of the Government of India's Empowered Committee on the Transformation of Aspirational Districts Program, which was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2018.
 
• Apolitical, a worldwide government learning platform, named Kant as one of the world's 50 most significant persons redefining governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **The NITI Aayog **is the Government of India's premier public policy think tank and the nodal organization tasked with stimulating economic development and building cooperative federalism through the bottom-up involvement of State Governments in the economic policy-making process.
 
• Its initiatives include the "15-year road map," "7-year vision, strategy, and action plan," AMRUT, Digital India, Atal Innovation Mission, Medical Education Reform, agriculture reforms (Model Land Leasing Law, Agricultural Produce Marketing Committee Act Reforms, Agricultural Marketing and Farmer Friendly Reforms Index for ranking states), Indices Measuring States' Performance in Health, Education, and Water Management, and Indices Measuring States' Performance in Health, Education, and Water Management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arvind Panagariya** is an Indian-American economist and a professor of economics at Columbia University. From January 2015 to August 2017, he was the** first vice-chairman** of the government of India think-tank NITI Aayog.
 
• Suman Bery is the current vice-chairperson of the NITI Aayog.
 
• **Currently, Parameswaran Iyer is the CEO of NITI Aayog appointed in June 2022.**
